# watchpoint_audit_webhook (Data Source)

Looks up a single audit-log webhook destination by name within the tenant. The HMAC signing secret is never exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_audit_webhook" "example" {
  name = "SIEM Forwarder"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the webhook destination to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook destination ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are active.
- `url` (String) HTTPS URL audit-log events are POSTed to.
